correctness.rationale: The lonesum criterion is exactly a union of two three-state Cartesian products; the complete four-column-frequency table yields a full Walsh formula. Odd mixed-column count cancels, even positive mixed-column count yields ±2·3^c, and the no-mixed branch cannot vanish for n≥2 because 3^c≠2^{n−1}. Two 01 frequency columns attain coefficient 2. Walsh diagonalization gives rank 2^{2n−1}, inverse norm 1/2 and the claimed projection. Exact code independently computed every coefficient through n=8 and graph acyclicity through n=5; infinite proof does not rely on it.

value.rationale: The classical 2-by-n lonesum family is a motivated reconstruction class, and Fourier rank/nonvanishing is a natural invariant of its indicator convolution. Complete all-n support and sharp nonzero gap show that reversal is the only Fourier information loss, identify the entire range, and give exact inverse and endpoint projection norms. This resolves a complete natural two-row case rather than a one-off arbitrary computation.
